data.narrative:
Hyperscale Power is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Daniel Rothmund (PhD ETH Zurich, ex-ABB) and Sami Pettersson (ex-ABB), which has raised €5M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers exist within this universe to support median-based valuation.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method applies here. Using total raised (€5M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of €12M. This reflects typical early-stage progression economics in frontier tech without reliance on sparse peer multiples.

The triangulation analysis supports a range of €11M (low) to €14M (high), with a median of €12M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific sector and founder profile, the absence of direct Seed-stage peers to validate progression assumptions, and the company's burn rate and runway relative to next funding inflection. A Peer-Median cross-check remains infeasible pending access to additional same-stage or valuation-tier comparables in climate tech.
